idea-plugin.name: Console Emulation Toggle
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a one-click toggle for the Emulate terminal in output console option of Python run configurations, so you can switch it without opening the Run/Debug Configurations dialog.

Some scripts need a real terminal: progress bars, curses interfaces, coloured output and libraries that check isatty(). Others are easier to read and search in the plain output console. This plugin makes switching between the two a single click.

Where to find it

  • Main toolbar (right side): changes the run configuration selected in the run widget.
  • Run and Debug tool window toolbar: changes the configuration that tab was started from, whatever is selected in the run widget. Click Rerun to apply the change right away.

The button's tooltip names the configuration and shows whether the option is on or off.

Things to know

  • It's per configuration. PyCharm stores this option on each run configuration, so each one keeps its own value, the same as if you'd changed it in the dialog. Shared configurations saved in .idea/runConfigurations are updated too.
  • It applies on the next run. A process that's already running isn't affected.
  • Python script configurations only. The main toolbar button is disabled when another kind of configuration is selected, or when the run widget is set to "Current File". The tool window button is hidden on tabs for other kinds of configuration.

Source code and issue tracker: GitHub.
